dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Three distinct horizontal rows of high-contrast white spots forming thick bands across dark gray primary and secondary coverts.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Visible as high-contrast white spots at the distal ends of the folded dark gray flight feathers.

other_distinctive_markers: Bright red pigmentation at the anterior-most tip (bill); prominent white rump patch; high-contrast white spots on the tail rectrices.
